title: Reproducibility Artifact for Asymmetric Cryptographic Interfaces for Noise-Degenerate SPDE Sensors
description: Corrected public reproducibility artifact for the associated manuscript. Includes software/reference models, RTL/FPGA work packages, consolidated data, figures, LaTeX-ready outputs, correction provenance, and—within the complete archive—raw Vivado/XSim evidence. Physical sensor entropy characterization (WP07/WP08) was not performed.
notes: Q16.16 precision correction documented in docs/CORRECTION_NOTICE.md. No software/data license was inferred from the source archive; authors should select the intended public license during deposition.
